questions.q: Akira lit 5 identical candles at the same time. They stopped burning at different times and now look as shown. Which candle stopped burning first? / Akira menyalakan 5 lilin yang serupa pada masa yang sama. Lilin itu terpadam pada masa berbeza dan kini kelihatan seperti dalam rajah. Lilin manakah yang terpadam dahulu?

Alice has these 4 puzzle pieces. Which 2 pieces can she put together to form the square shown? / Alice mempunyai 4 kepingan suai gambar ini. 2 kepingan manakah yang boleh dicantum untuk membentuk segi empat sama yang ditunjukkan?

Anna has 4 discs of different sizes. She wants to build a tower of 3 discs so that every disc is smaller than the disc below it. How many different towers can Anna make? / Anna mempunyai 4 cakera yang berlainan saiz. Dia mahu membina menara 3 cakera supaya setiap cakera lebih kecil daripada cakera di bawahnya. Berapakah bilangan menara berbeza yang boleh dibina?

Helga lives with her father, mother, brother, one dog, two cats, two parrots and four fish. What is the total number of legs they have altogether? / Helga tinggal bersama bapa, ibu, adik, seekor anjing, dua ekor kucing, dua ekor burung kakak tua dan empat ekor ikan. Berapakah jumlah kaki mereka semua?

The figure shows the number 930. How many squares must be switched from black to white or from white to black to obtain the number 806 (bottom)? / Rajah menunjukkan nombor 930. Berapakah bilangan petak yang mesti ditukar daripada hitam kepada putih atau putih kepada hitam untuk mendapat nombor 806 (bawah)?

A square piece of paper has been cut into three pieces. Two of them are shown. What is the third piece? / Sekeping kertas segi empat sama dipotong kepada tiga bahagian. Dua daripadanya ditunjukkan. Apakah bahagian yang ketiga?

Ivo is playing darts. He has 10 darts. For each throw that hits the centre, he gains two extra darts. At the end of the round, Ivo has thrown 20 darts. How many times did he hit the centre? / Ivo bermain dart. Dia mempunyai 10 dart. Bagi setiap lontaran yang kena sasaran tengah, dia mendapat dua dart tambahan. Pada akhir pusingan, Ivo telah melontar 20 dart. Berapa kalikah dia kena sasaran tengah?
Figure X is the opposite of figure Y. Which figure is the opposite of figure G? / Rajah X ialah songsangan bagi rajah Y. Rajah manakah songsangan bagi rajah G?

There are three songs on a CD. The first is 6 minutes 25 seconds long, the second is 12 minutes 25 seconds and the third is 10 minutes 13 seconds. How long are all three songs together? / Terdapat tiga lagu dalam sebuah CD. Lagu pertama 6 minit 25 saat, lagu kedua 12 minit 25 saat dan lagu ketiga 10 minit 13 saat. Berapakah jumlah durasi ketiga-tiga lagu itu?

Which number must go in the first cloud to make all the calculations correct? ? → −2 → ☐ → ÷3 → ☐ → +4 → 5 / Nombor apakah yang perlu dimasukkan dalam awan pertama supaya semua pengiraan betul? ? → −2 → ☐ → ÷3 → ☐ → +4 → 5

Ali has a 60 cm ruler. Some of the markings have faded. He can measure any of the lengths 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60 cm using his ruler only once. Which marks are still on Ali's ruler? / Ali mempunyai pembaris 60 cm. Beberapa tanda ukur telah pudar. Dia boleh mengukur mana-mana panjang 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 dan 60 cm dengan menggunakan pembarisnya sekali sahaja. Tanda manakah yang masih ada pada pembaris Ali?

There are 8 cars waiting for a ferry. Every car contains either 2 or 3 people. In total there are 19 people. How many cars contain exactly 2 people? / Terdapat 8 buah kereta menunggu feri. Setiap kereta membawa sama ada 2 atau 3 orang. Jumlahnya 19 orang. Berapakah bilangan kereta yang membawa tepat 2 orang?

Rebecca folds a square piece of paper twice. Then she cuts off one corner. Next, she unfolds the paper. What does the paper look like once it is unfolded? / Rebecca melipat sekeping kertas segi empat sama dua kali. Kemudian dia memotong satu bucu. Seterusnya dia membuka lipatan kertas itu. Apakah rupa kertas itu selepas dibuka?

Hermione, Harry and Ron always walk into the common room one at a time. Hermione is never first, Harry is never second and Ron is never third. In how many different orders could they walk in? / Hermione, Harry dan Ron sentiasa masuk ke bilik rehat seorang demi seorang. Hermione tidak pernah pertama, Harry tidak pernah kedua dan Ron tidak pernah ketiga. Berapakah bilangan turutan berbeza mereka masuk?

There are six weights of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 kg. Rossitza puts five of them on the scales and puts one weight aside. The scales are balanced, as shown. Which weight did she put aside? / Terdapat enam pemberat 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 dan 6 kg. Rossitza meletakkan lima daripadanya di atas penimbang dan mengetepikan satu. Penimbang itu seimbang, seperti dalam rajah. Pemberat manakah yang diketepikan?

A farmer has boxes of 6 eggs and boxes of 12 eggs. What is the smallest number of boxes he needs to store 66 eggs? / Seorang pekebun mempunyai kotak 6 biji telur dan kotak 12 biji telur. Berapakah bilangan kotak paling sedikit yang diperlukan untuk menyimpan 66 biji telur?

Irena, Ann, Kate, Olga and Elena live in the same house: two of the girls live on the first floor, three on the second floor. Olga lives on a different floor from Kate and Elena. Ann lives on a different floor from Irena and Kate. Who lives on the first floor? / Irena, Ann, Kate, Olga dan Elena tinggal di rumah yang sama: dua orang di tingkat satu, tiga orang di tingkat dua. Olga tinggal di tingkat berbeza daripada Kate dan Elena. Ann tinggal di tingkat berbeza daripada Irena dan Kate. Siapakah yang tinggal di tingkat satu?

John multiplies by 3, Pete adds 2 and Nick subtracts 1. In what order can they do this to change 3 into 14? / John mendarab dengan 3, Pete menambah 2 dan Nick menolak 1. Dalam turutan apakah mereka boleh menukar 3 kepada 14?
Three balloons cost 12 cents more than one balloon. How many cents does one balloon cost? / Tiga biji belon berharga 12 sen lebih daripada sebiji belon. Berapakah harga sebiji belon, dalam sen?

John starts a chain letter. He sends a letter to his mate Peter. Peter must send it to 2 other people, and everyone who receives it must also send it to 2 other people. After 2 rounds, 1 + 2 + 4 = 7 people have received the letter. How many people in total have received the letter after 4 rounds? / John memulakan surat berantai. Dia menghantar surat kepada rakannya Peter. Peter perlu menghantarnya kepada 2 orang lain, dan setiap penerima juga perlu menghantarnya kepada 2 orang lain. Selepas 2 pusingan, 1 + 2 + 4 = 7 orang telah menerima surat itu. Berapakah jumlah orang yang telah menerima surat itu selepas 4 pusingan?
